Cost: 500eb (Expensive) ♦ Enhances: All Bulletproof Shields

You know the song, the suit, and the reference. So assemble them.

Shield Enhancement. Cannot be equipped to any Bulletproof Shield installed in a Popup Shield, and the Shield now cannot be installed in a Popup Shield. As long as it has any HP remaining, the Bulletproof Shield may now be Thrown as if it was a Very Heavy Melee Weapon, which is done at a -2 penalty to the Athletics Check for doing so. If the user has active Speedware and a total Initiative Bonus of +4 or higher, the shield returns to them at the beginning of their next Turn wherever they may be on the battlefield by bouncing off the closest valid surface(s). The user may choose to catch it without an Action if they have a hand free to do so. Otherwise, it lands somewhere on the ground nearby as chosen by the GM.

Type: Shield Enhancement
Attachment slots: 0

Foundry notes:

  • Shield Attachments and Enhancements follow the Armor Attachment and Enhancement rules, but for Bulletproof Shields, including cyberware ones; not for vehicle Bulletproof Glass. Corgo's optional rule: a Bulletproof Shield with HP left puts its wielder in Cover and counts as a 2x2m/yds piece of Cover against Suppressive Fire, which they may share with one adjacent character.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Armor & Fashion > Shields).
